title: The Hollow
tagline: A dark-fantasy horror expedition for 1–6. Explore a vanished village, make terrible bargains, and decide whether the bell is silenced, rung backward, sold, or broken.

roles.name: Player
roles.description: Host an expedition and share the 4-letter code, or join one. Solo play and ghost companions work offline.

multiplayer.style: co-op horror RPG with secret objectives, server-authoritative, room code
multiplayer.notes: Online expeditions run on the game's own Socket.io server (server/index.mjs, loaded by npm start). Every roll, reward and rule is decided on the server; each player is sent only what they may know. Rooms are saved to disk so a restart does not end an expedition. Solo play (with optional AI ghost companions) runs the same engine locally and works offline.
